assessments.summary: The audited verifier exhaustively evaluates all 524,288 law-map pairs, rigorously encloses the finite-family maximum in [0.5451904011322205365, 0.5451904011322206215] bits, and certifies row 7/map 243761 with tuple (1,0,3,0,0,2,3,2,3) as attaining the lower endpoint. Using the required RTD threshold certificate, the upper endpoint is strictly below 2 L_RTD.
scopeQualifications: The result applies only to the two pinned exact rational auxiliary laws and deterministic maps from nine labels to four two-use BSSC super-inputs.
It excludes stochastic relabelings, altered auxiliary laws, mixtures or continuations, local-search campaigns, unrestricted Marton additivity, and any capacity converse.
No value inside the certified enclosure is claimed to greater precision.
The local source bytes are pinned, but their external repository history is not independently authenticated; this is provenance rather than a mathematical premise.
